title: 第15章 这怎么是只没毛老鼠啊第16章 混沌丹经
content_zh:
走出坊市大门，陆宸嘴角微掀，露出一丝冷笑，接着加快脚步，朝着人少的巷子走去。
不久后，陆宸走到一个安静的死巷，只见他从容的停下了脚步，然后回身看向身后。
陆宸冷喝道：“跟了我这么久，现在我已经走投无路了，你确定还不出来见一下？”
“啪啪啪！”
随着一阵掌声的出现，拐角处一个手持大刀，武道为七重武士境的中年男子走了出来，一步步的逼近陆宸。
陆宸略带嘲讽道：“你可真会做生意，前脚卖，后脚就跟上来了。”
不错，此刻盯上陆宸的这个男子不是别人，正是之前在坊市卖给陆宸血灵芝的摊主。
李宇冷道：“老东西，大爷不想和你废话，立刻把东西交出来。”
陆宸道：“只要血灵芝，不要命？”
李宇眼睛微眯，迸出一抹寒光：“把血灵芝交出来，我可以留你全尸，否则你怕是会死得很惨。”
不要命？
这怎么可能，他还想用血灵芝钓更多的土财主呢，怎么可能留着一个人败坏他的名声。
陆宸也看透了李宇，冷笑道：“那我可真要谢谢你了，居然给我想的这么周到，还想给我一个全尸。”
李宇寒声质问道：“不给？”
“我确实不想给你，你若有本事就来拿。”
陆宸冷道。
“那你就给我死吧！”
一言不合，李宇纵身跃起，手持大刀一刀对着陆宸砍下。
随着李宇这一刀砍下，刀身上燃烧起丝丝火焰，刀锋所至，空气发出爆破之音，威力不弱。
李宇对自己这一刀很自信，这么多年了，他凭借着一刀杀了数十个武士境武者，从未失手。

不过，这一次他注定要为自己的行为买单，因为他惹上的人不是一般的武士境武者，而是曾经的封号武帝的陆宸。
看着杀来的李宇，陆宸眼中没有丝毫惧意，只见陆宸施展凌霄步一步踏出，消失在了原地。
下一秒，李宇一刀砍空，紧接着，一个冰冷的声音在李宇身后响起。
“奔雷拳！”
声音未落，李宇脸色大变，慌忙提刀抵挡。
不过，陆宸并不给李宇机会，他的速度太快了，李宇刚反应过来，他的拳头已经到了李宇头上。
嘭！
一声闷响，李宇双眼瞬间充血，整个人飞了出去，猛的砸在墙上，然后摔倒在巷角里。
“你……”
砰！
一拳，陆宸以蛮力直中李宇要害，李宇不甘的挣扎了一下，接着倒了下去，彻底没有了呼吸。
杀死李宇，陆宸面无表情的走到李宇尸体旁，从他手里撸下储物戒，快速消失在了巷子里。
出了巷子，陆宸像个没事人一样走在西区的大街上，等到离开西区，他施展凌霄步朝着陆家奔去。
content_en:
After walking out of the gate of Fangshi, Lu Chen raised the corner of his mouth slightly, revealing a sneer, then quickened his pace and walked towards the less crowded alley.
Not long after, Lu Chen came to a quiet dead-end alley and saw him calmly stop, then turn around and look behind him.
Lu Chen shouted coldly: "You've been following me for so long, and now I'm desperate. Are you sure you don't want to come out and see me?"
"Bah bang bang!"
With a burst of applause, a middle-aged man holding a broadsword and a seventh-level warrior in martial arts came out from the corner and approached Lu Chen step by step.
Lu Chen said with a hint of ridicule: "You are really good at doing business. You sell on the front foot and follow up on the back foot."
Yes, the man who was eyeing Lu Chen at the moment was none other than the stall owner who had sold Lu Chen blood Ganoderma lucidum in Fangshi.
Li Yu said coldly: "Old man, I don't want to talk nonsense with you, so hand over your things immediately."
Lu Chen said: "As long as you want blood Ganoderma lucidum, you don't want your life?"
Li Yu narrowed his eyes slightly and flashed a cold light: "Hand over the blood Ganoderma lucidum, and I can keep your whole body, otherwise you may die miserably."
Don't want your life?
How is this possible? He still wants to use Blood Ganoderma to catch more local rich people. How can he keep one person to ruin his reputation?
Lu Chen also saw through Li Yu and sneered: "Then I really want to thank you for thinking so thoughtfully about me and even wanting to give me a whole body."
Li Yu asked in a cold voice: "No?"
"I really don't want to give it to you. If you have the ability, come and get it."
Lu Chen said coldly.
"Then just die!"
After a disagreement, Li Yu jumped up and slashed at Lu Chen with a big knife.
As Li Yu slashed with the sword, flames burned on the blade. When the blade touched, the air made an explosion sound, and the power was not weak.
Li Yu is very confident in his sword. For so many years, he has killed dozens of warriors in the warrior realm with one sword and has never failed.
However, this time he was destined to pay for his actions, because the person he provoked was not an ordinary warrior in the warrior realm, but Lu Chen, the former titled Martial Emperor.
Looking at Li Yu who was coming to kill him, Lu Chen didn't have the slightest fear in his eyes. He only saw Lu Chen using Ling Xiao to step out step by step and disappear from the spot.
The next second, Li Yu slashed into the air, and then a cold voice sounded behind Li Yu.
"Thunder Fist!"
Before the voice fell, Li Yu's face changed drastically and he hurriedly raised his knife to resist.
However, Lu Chen did not give Li Yu a chance. His speed was too fast. As soon as Li Yu reacted, his fist had already reached Li Yu's head.
Bang!
There was a muffled sound, and Li Yu's eyes instantly became bloodshot. He flew out, slammed into the wall, and then fell into the corner of the alley.
"You..."
Bang!
With one punch, Lu Chen hit Li Yu's vital part with brute force. Li Yu struggled unwillingly and then fell down, completely out of breath.
After killing Li Yu, Lu Chen walked to Li Yu's body expressionlessly, took the storage ring from his hand, and quickly disappeared into the alley.
After leaving the alley, Lu Chen walked on the streets of the West District like a normal person. When he left the West District, he used Ling Xiaobu and ran towards Lu's house.
